references.text: The introduction to the lampstand made of pure gold, hammered work, which is elaborated on in verse 36.
Bezalel carried out the work on the lampstand exactly as commanded, including that the knobs and branches should be of one piece of pure, hammered gold.
Confirms that the lampstand was made of hammered gold, a single piece of work, just as the Lord had shown Moses.
The cherubim on the mercy seat were also to be made of hammered work (מִקְשָׁה), the same technique used for the lampstand.
The cherubim were made of hammered gold, paralleling the construction of the lampstand.
Solomon's temple had lampstands of pure gold, continuing the tradition from the tabernacle.
John sees seven golden lampstands in his vision, symbolically connecting to the golden lampstand in the tabernacle.
This text confirms that the instruction regarding unity and pure gold in 25:36 was fully carried out as described here.
